final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* ibias -> nc -> RC2 -> diode MB0 (nb).  nc = NMOS cascode gate
RB2  ibias nb 25000
MB0  nb nb vss vss nfet W=2 L=1
* PMOS bias: Mpb diode (pb) -> RC1 -> pc -> MB1 sink (20uA)
MB1  pc nb vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
RB1  pb pc 10000
Mpb  pb pb vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=0.5
* ---------------- input pair + tail ----------------
MT   tail nb vss vss nfet W=50 L=1
M1   xl vinp tail vss nfet W=25 L=0.3
M2   xr vinn tail vss nfet W=25 L=0.3
* ---------------- PMOS current sources (fold nodes) ----------------
Mp1  xl pb vdd vdd pfet W=50 L=0.5
Mp2  xr pb vdd vdd pfet W=50 L=0.5
* ---------------- PMOS cascodes ----------------
Mp3  fl pc xl vdd pfet W=30 L=0.3
Mp4  vout pc xr vdd pfet W=30 L=0.3
* ---------------- low-voltage NMOS cascode mirror ----------------
Mn3  fl ibias a1 vss nfet W=15 L=0.3
Mn4  vout ibias a2 vss nfet W=15 L=0.3
Mn1  a1 fl vss vss nfet W=15 L=0.8
Mn2  a2 fl vss vss nfet W=15 L=0.8
.ends dut
